sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会剖析《办公室》的一集，并分享独家幕后

sentences.en: Not that I'm not always excited, but I don't know.

It was a surprise to me.

sentences.en: So it was just fun to be an audience.

一个由我带来的精彩梗概？

I'm going to sip my tea and listen and only judge a little.

sentences.zh: 我之前提到过这一集是由保罗编剧并执导的，但实际上这是

sentences.en: He had a great, great time.
Well, he said that he was so excited to be able to write and direct this episode because
sentences.zh: 他说他当时特别兴奋能编导这一集，因为

因为我们之前去过那儿。

sentences.en: We saw the barn in the initiation and all that.

sentences.en: But he got to completely invent Dwight's home and what it looked like and all of that stuff.

sentences.zh: 他说他想让德怀特经营一家民宿的想法，源于几年前
去意大利旅行时的经历。

sentences.en: So while he was in Italy, he had seen a bunch of signs for this farm B&B stay.

sentences.en: You go stay on people's farms in Italy.
sentences.zh: 你可以去意大利人的农场里住。

sentences.en: I just want Paul to know, if you're listening, Paul, you don't have to go all the way to Italy
sentences.zh: 我只想让保罗知道，如果你在听的话，保罗，你没必要非得跑那么远去意大利

sentences.en: You can have a farm B&B right here.
sentences.zh: 你在这儿就能体验到农场民宿。

sentences.en: I'm sure like my family farm in Texas would take you in.
sentences.zh: 我相信我德克萨斯州的老家农场肯定会欢迎你的。

sentences.en: I would love to have a farm B&B experience at your parents' farm.
sentences.zh: 我太想去你父母的农场体验一下民宿了。

sentences.en: I would love that so much.
I would love to get up in the morning and go check on the cows with you.
sentences.zh: 我好想早上起床跟你一起去看看牛。

sentences.en: Oh, lady, you're speaking my language.

sentences.zh: 他还告诉我，为了这一集他做了非常多的准备工作。

sentences.en: He really like overprepared because it was just a really big deal to him.
sentences.zh: 他真的很喜欢过度准备，因为这对当时的他来说确实是一件大事。

这里面有很多很棒的细节。

sentences.en: And we're going to point them out to you as they come up.
sentences.zh: 我们会在接下来的节目中一一为你指出。

sentences.en: Fast fact number two is a location breakdown.
sentences.zh: 第二个冷知识是关于拍摄地点的解析。
施鲁特农场的拍摄地点解析。

sentences.en: I have been to this farm many times.
sentences.zh: 我去过这个农场很多次了。
让我们听听你有什么发现。

sentences.en: So we mentioned before that we shot Shrute Farms on the Disney Ranch in Santa Clarita,
sentences.zh: 我们之前提到过，我们在圣克拉里塔的迪士尼牧场拍摄了施鲁特农场，

sentences.en: We went back for this episode.
sentences.zh: 这一集我们又回到了那里。

sentences.en: And this time we used the Olivia's House location.
sentences.zh: 这次我们使用的是“奥利维亚之家”的拍摄点。

sentences.en: That is the farmhouse that we transformed into Dwight's B&B.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们改造成德怀特民宿的农舍。

sentences.en: Yes, you guys should know this is a vast property and they have different areas where they film.
sentences.zh: 没错，你们应该知道这是一片广阔的场地，他们有不同的区域可供拍摄。

sentences.en: So they have the barn, right, where you saw the initiation.
sentences.zh: 他们有谷仓，就是你们看到入会仪式的地方，对吧？

sentences.en: And then they have little houses and different areas that you can use to create sort of this
sentences.zh: 然后还有一些小房子和不同的区域，你可以利用它们来营造出一种

sentences.en: rustic look for TV and film.
sentences.zh: 适合影视拍摄的乡村风貌。

sentences.en: But these houses, they're just shells.
sentences.zh: 但这些房子其实只是空壳。

sentences.en: They're just like exterior shell walls.
sentences.zh: 它们就像是外墙的空壳一样。

sentences.en: So it got very, very cold at night.
Any of the night scenes, we were freezing.
sentences.zh: 任何夜间场景，我们都冻得要命。

sentences.en: And everything is a little bit dusty.
Like if you sit on something, like a little cloud of like, yeah, it kind of comes out of it.
sentences.zh: 如果你坐在什么东西上，就会有一小团灰尘冒出来，没错，就是那样。

sentences.en: And our set designers had to go in and they had to meticulously decorate every single room.
sentences.zh: 我们的布景设计师必须进去，一丝不苟地装饰每一个房间。

sentences.en: Every item you see, we put there.
sentences.zh: 你看到的每一件物品，都是我们放进去的。

sentences.en: I have a feeling they went in first and cleaned and then decorated.
sentences.zh: 我感觉他们是先进去打扫，然后再进行装饰的。

sentences.en: Why is my memory of shrewd parms so dusty?
sentences.zh: 为什么我对施鲁特农场的记忆里全是灰尘？

sentences.en: Well, I remember sneezing a lot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我记得我当时一直在打喷嚏。

sentences.en: You know, you wouldn't want to lean against the wall.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你肯定不想靠在墙上。

sentences.en: You might go right through it.
sentences.zh: 你可能会直接穿墙而过。

sentences.en: Now, we have another location in this episode.
sentences.zh: 现在，这一集里我们还有另一个拍摄地点。

sentences.en: Michael takes a job as a telemarketer.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔找了一份电话推销员的工作。

sentences.en: And I asked Kentopedia about this location.
sentences.zh: 我向“肯特百科”询问了这个地点。

sentences.en: The exterior, when you see him walking into the building, we shot that in Van Nuys.
sentences.zh: 外景部分，当你看到他走进那栋大楼时，我们是在范奈司拍摄的。
那就在我们工作室附近。

sentences.en: But the inside of the building, we shot on the 10th floor of the LA Times building in downtown LA.
sentences.zh: 但建筑内部，我们是在洛杉矶市中心《洛杉矶时报》大楼的10楼拍摄的。

sentences.en: This shocked me because this building is stunning.
sentences.zh: 这让我震惊，因为这栋建筑太惊艳了。

sentences.en: It housed the LA Times until 2017.
sentences.zh: 它曾是《洛杉矶时报》的总部，直到2017年。

sentences.en: It was designed by this man named Gordon B.
sentences.zh: 它是由一位名叫戈登·B·考夫曼的人设计的。

sentences.en: Kaufman in the Art Deco style in the 1930s.
sentences.zh: 他在20世纪30年代采用了装饰艺术风格。

sentences.en: It won a gold medal at the 1937 Paris Exposition.
sentences.zh: 它在1937年的巴黎博览会上获得过金奖。

sentences.en: And it's just, it's so weird to me that this very, like, ordinary telemarketing office is housed inside of this gorgeous piece of architecture.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这样一个非常普通的电话营销办公室竟然坐落在这座华丽的建筑里，真是太奇怪了。

sentences.en: I know, that is so wild because we don't do that building justice at all.
sentences.zh: 我知道，这太疯狂了，因为我们完全没有展现出这栋建筑的价值。

sentences.en: We make it look just like any cubicle office anywhere, right?
sentences.zh: 我们把它拍得就像任何地方的格子间办公室一样，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, I shot a commercial in my 20s in downtown LA.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我20多岁时在洛杉矶市中心拍过一个广告。

sentences.en: And I was really stunned because it was a gorgeous building and we were shooting on, like, the 12th floor.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的很震惊，因为那是一栋非常华丽的建筑，我们是在12楼拍摄的。

sentences.en: And then they had, like, craft and service on a different floor.
sentences.zh: 然后他们在另一层楼设置了餐饮和后勤服务区。

sentences.en: You know, they used a few floors.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们用了好几层楼。

sentences.en: And it was, like, three floors in a row with no people.
sentences.zh: 而且连续三层楼都没有人。

sentences.en: So, I think there are, like, sort of buildings downtown that have just a lot of vacancy.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得市中心有些建筑确实有很多空置空间。

sentences.en: It was really eerie because we were filming at night and it was, like, a dark corridor.
sentences.zh: 那真的很诡异，因为我们是在晚上拍摄的，走廊里黑漆漆的。

sentences.en: Well, I visited the LA Times back in college as part of a film and television summer workshop that was coordinated by UCLA.
sentences.zh: 我上大学时曾参观过《洛杉矶时报》，那是加州大学洛杉矶分校组织的电影电视暑期研讨会的一部分。

sentences.en: And we got to go in and see how they make newspapers.
sentences.zh: 我们有机会进去看看他们是如何制作报纸的。

sentences.en: It has this great big globe and I have all these pictures.
sentences.zh: 里面有一个巨大的地球仪，我拍了很多照片。

sentences.en: I would sign up for that.
I mean, you know, I love a tour.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，我喜欢参观。

sentences.en: We would sign up for almost any tour.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎愿意报名参加任何参观活动。

sentences.en: I mean, I feel like we could do a podcast where it's just you and I taking tours and talking about today we went to the peanut factory.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我觉得我们可以做一个播客，内容就是你和我去参观各种地方，然后聊聊今天我们去了花生工厂之类的。

sentences.en: Oh, lady, that's a brilliant idea.
sentences.zh: 噢，亲爱的，这主意太棒了。

sentences.en: We travel and go on tours and then tell people about the tour we went on.
sentences.zh: 我们去旅行、去参观，然后告诉大家我们参观的经历。

sentences.en: I mean, selfishly, I want to do that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，私心来讲，我很想做这件事。

sentences.en: Well, speaking of travel, fast fact number three, TripAdvisor features very heavily in this episode.
sentences.zh: 说到旅行，第三个速览事实，TripAdvisor在这一集中占了很大篇幅。

sentences.zh: 但安吉拉，那一集里没提到的另一条评论，是斯普林克尔斯的主人写的。

sentences.en: It says, I have to warn people about the proprietor of Shroot FarMs.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，我必须提醒大家关于施鲁特农场的店主。

sentences.en: He may portray himself as a gentleman farmer, but he is not what he seeMs.
sentences.zh: 他可能把自己包装成一个绅士农场主，但他表里不一。

sentences.en: Who knows what he might do to you or your loved ones?
sentences.zh: 谁知道他还会对你或你的亲人做出什么事来？

sentences.en: So the profiles are no longer there and those reviews are no longer there.
sentences.zh: 所以那些个人资料已经不在了，那些评论也都不在了。

sentences.en: But Shroot Farms is still a page on TripAdvisor.

sentences.en: It has over 1,300 reviews and it has four stars.
sentences.zh: 它有超过1300条评论，评分是四星。

sentences.en: I went on the Shroot Farms TripAdvisor page.

sentences.en: So TripAdvisor, you might want to update that.

sentences.en: We just agreed to do it.
sentences.zh: 我们只是同意这么做而已。

sentences.en: And then the other thing I thought was kind of cool about this, and it's a little bit of
sentences.zh: 还有另一件事我觉得挺酷的，这算是一个小小的。

Did this person really drive to this weird remote location in Pennsylvania, hoping to find
sentences.zh: 这个人真的开车去了宾夕法尼亚州那个偏僻又古怪的地方，希望能找到

sentences.zh: 你肯定知道至少有一个人，对吧，不知道那是
